# 🛡️ MITRE ATT&CK Detection Coverage Dashboard

Author: **Sunny Bhardwaj**  
Last Updated: 2026

This workbook visualizes which MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques are covered by our active detection rules. Use this to identify coverage gaps and prioritize new detection development.

---

## 📉 Coverage Gaps - Recommended Next Detections

Based on MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise matrix, here are tactics with limited or no coverage:

- **Defense Evasion (TA0005)** — No detections yet. Consider: log clearing (T1070), token manipulation (T1134)
- **Discovery (TA0007)** — No detections yet. Consider: account discovery (T1087), network scanning (T1046)
- **Lateral Movement (TA0008)** — Limited coverage. Consider: pass-the-hash (T1550), remote services (T1021)
- **Exfiltration (TA0010)** — No detections yet. Consider: DNS tunneling (T1048), cloud storage abuse (T1567)
- **Impact (TA0040)** — No detections yet. Consider: ransomware indicators (T1486), account access removal (T1531)
